display_name: SQL Server well headers and tables
summary: Operator-approved SQL Server tables of well locations and headers through a reviewed mapping, or any table as it is with the person's declarations; read only.

losses: Coordinates are as stored; the declared CRS is not transformed
Tables are read in pages of 1,000 rows inside one snapshot-isolation transaction, up to 100,000 rows and 64 MiB; a database without snapshot isolation is inspected but not captured
datetime2 and datetimeoffset values keep six fraction digits; the seventh fraction digit is dropped
char and nchar values keep their trailing padding
unsupported: Windows, Kerberos or Entra ID sign-in
schema changes without a new reviewed mapping

routes.data: Any table, as its columns and rows
losses: Columns of types outside the eight logical types (geography, xml, varbinary and others) are listed as not read; their values are not delivered and a change in them is not detected
Declared units, descriptions, missing-value markers and coordinates are annotations; no value is converted
A table is read once inside one snapshot-isolation transaction, up to 100,000 rows, 64 MiB and 128 columns; a database without snapshot isolation is inspected but not captured
char and nchar values keep their trailing padding
unsupported: schema changes without a new reviewed declaration

redistribution: Ophiolite source; the SQL Server is customer-operated. The python-tds (MIT) and pyOpenSSL (Apache-2.0) drivers are installed with the `databases` extra.
